subject: How can I add a variable to the zero-inflation component in inla?

messages.author: cdab574041a91fc9
messages.subject: How can I add a variable to the zero-inflation component in inla?
parts:
Hi,
I'm trying to run a zero-inflated model. How can I add a variable to the zero-inflation component in inla?
For example, in glmmTMB I could run this code for zero-inflated negative binomial:
model<-glmmTMB(outcome~var1+offset(log(E))+(1|area), ziformula=~var2,family="nbinom2" ...)
so, var1 is in the conditional model and var2 in the zero-inflation model
How can I get something similar with inla?
I would also like to know how to obtain the intercepts of the random effect (area) in inla, similarly to ranef(model)

messages.author: 66ed4f72a898a51c
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] How can I add a variable to the zero-inflation component in inla?
parts:
Hi,

You can build a 2-column data matrix, one with the positives and other with zero and ones, misaligned. I wrote an example (attached) to start with.

best regards,

Elias
